text:
marta: Heads up — warm pool in ap-southeast-1 hasn't been filling for ~20m. Provisioning attempts failing during node bootstrap with KMS decrypt errors. We're seeing queued requests pile for a few routes. Raising here.

sam: logs?

marta: paste logs below:
```
[2026-03-20T10:14:02Z] bootstrap: decrypt kube-bootstrap.key failed: KMS_DECRYPT AccessDenied
[2026-03-20T10:14:03Z] bootstrap: failed to fetch bootstrap artifact, retrying...
[2026-03-20T10:14:11Z] node-provisioner: instance i-0abc1234 FAILED_ATTACH_KEY
```

lee: we merged the egress lockdown change ~30m ago (PR #2492). It swapped 0.0.0.0/0 outbound for a prefix-list of allowed endpoints. Did we include the regional KMS endpoint for ap-southeast-1?

indra: checking VPC endpoints & SGs now.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: firewall/egress-lockdown #2492 by lee at 2026-03-20T09:52:00Z :white_check_mark:

indra: VPC endpoint exists but the NAT/egress SG only allows S3/Privatelink traffic. HTTPS to kms.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com is blocked — prefix-list missing KMS.

marta: that explains the decrypt failures, nodes can't reach KMS to unwrap the bootstrap key.

sam: impact: warm-pool down ~18 GPUs vs target, autoscaler keeps launching instances that fail bootstrap (so we're paying for partial cycles) and request latency spikes for some customer routes hitting dedicated pools.

lee: ops question — faster to revert the SG change or add KMS to the prefix-list?

indra: prefix-list update might take 5-10m to propagate. Reverting the SG rule is immediate. If we want minimal blast-radius, revert for the affected VPC only.

marta: I'll open a revert now and plan a follow-up to add KMS properly. Also thinking we should rotate the bootstrap key after we restore access to be safe.

sam: CloudWatch audit shows denies too, snippet:
```
{ "eventTime": "2026-03-20T10:15:00Z", "eventName": "Decrypt", "userIdentity": {"arn":"arn:aws:sts::111:assumed-role/node-bootstrap"}, "errorMessage":"AccessDenied", "sourceIP":"10.0.12.48" }
```

lee: i'm reverting the SG rule in prod vpc-analytics-ap-southeast-1 now, will ping when done.

indra: i'll open a follow-up to add KMS to the prefix-list and to terraform-validate that egress rules include kms endpoints per-region. Also add a unit test to the egress module.

lee: revert applied: firewall/egress-lockdown #2492 reverted for vpc-analytics-ap-southeast-1.

deploy-bot: revert applied: firewall/egress-lockdown #2492 reverted by lee at 2026-03-20T10:20:12Z

marta: re-triggering warm pool reconcile: `./infractl warmpool reconcile --region ap-southeast-1`

sam: watching node-provisioner logs...

```
[2026-03-20T10:21:30Z] bootstrap: decrypt succeeded
[2026-03-20T10:21:32Z] node-provisioner: instance i-0abc1234 ATTACHED_KEY
[2026-03-20T10:21:50Z] warmpool: increased +6 -> target
```

indra: good. Follow-ups: 1) add KMS to the central prefix-list and propagate to all egress SGs, 2) add terraform plan checks for kms endpoint coverage, 3) create an alert for spikes in KMS Decrypt AccessDenied errors, and 4) add a cost mitigation to cancel instance boot attempts after N failed boot cycles.

marta: i'll stub a postmortem, tag eng-infra + eng-security, and own the bootstrap key rotation plan.

sam: :thumbsup:
